study/hypothesis: From every beat, |ΔRR| is far larger in 119 than in 16265; from NN intervals only, the two records differ by no more than a few ms.
study/name: Do ectopic beats fake heart-rate variability?
study/question: Are successive RR-interval differences larger in a record with ventricular bigeminy (MIT-BIH 119) than in a healthy heart (NSR 16265) only because of the ectopic beats, i.e. does the difference vanish when only normal-to-normal intervals are used?
